newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Black says Hollinger US profit rising.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Black says Hollinger US profit rising.

text.p: Hollinger International Inc chairman and chief executive Conrad Black said on Wednesday that gross profit from U.S. operations would rise to over US$100 million this year and profits from Canada would be even larger.

"Our profit in the United States, our gross profit, will be well over 100 million dollars U.S. this year and will be even larger in Canada," Black told the annual meeting of newspaper group John Fairfax Holdings Ltd in Sydney.
Black said reports in some newspapers that his companies were doing poorly and that he would be a distressed seller of his 25 percent Fairfax stake were nonsense.
"In all of our units cash flows are rising," Black said.
"In Britain we've emerged extremely successfully from this price war," he said.
Hollinger International holds its stake in John Fairfax Holdings through Britain's The Telegraph Plc.
Black's other interests include the Chicago Sun-Times, the Jerusalem Post and a controlling interest in Canadian newspaper chain Southam Inc. -- Bernard Hickey 61-2 9373-1812
